output.summary: The zero-deviation record is almost certainly an artifact of the February 2026 supervisor bonus penalty per deviation. Independent QC lot rejections and customer complaints rose over the same period, which contradicts real improvement. Line 3 output is explained by borrowed Line 1 and 4 technicians, with productivity per technician-hour unchanged, so its practices are not transferable. Line 3 also accounts for 71% of traceable luer-bond complaints, which suggests hidden rework, though that is not yet confirmed. Tubing supplier change is a weak explanation because other lines using the same tubing show few complaints. Preferred actions: suspend the penalty with amnesty and non-retaliation, and run an independent investigation. Do not roll out Line 3, discipline anyone yet, or unmask the hotline reporter.
